items.title: 68429_Walter P. Thomas oral history interview
items.q: I had him... I booked him all in good places.

ctx.x: Oh, the miles were close. 150-200 miles. And I had been booking a lot of them clubs and things. Because there was a jam(?) of little clubs in that Philadelphia area and the Virginia area where they couldn't get a date on Domino. Because he only had about six or seven dates I could get in two weeks if I was playing the Friday, Saturday and Sunday. So I figured out my first Sunday I'd book him in Washington. And I had him
